bio: I am an assistant professor in the Department of Mathematics at Kangwon National University, where I lead the KNU Coding Theory Team. My research is centered on algebraic coding theory: linear codes over finite fields and finite rings, self-dual codes, and other codes with rich algebraic structure. Building on this structure, I study deletion-correcting codes, DNA codes for DNA-based data storage, and quantum information theory, including quantum error correction and quantum circuits. I design codes with tools from algebra and combinatorics and verify them by computation in Magma and Python.
